name: recoil_app_run
description: RecoilApp::Run is the main application loop: it pumps Windows messages, polls DirectPlay while idle, processes queued state transitions, runs the current state's update/quit hook, posts quit on deactivation, and blocks with WaitMessage only when the skip-wait flag permits it.
known_limits: The native smokes cover the current-state update-requests-quit path and queued switch, push, and exit-current transitions with patched message-pump imports; broader message-pump integration remains source-reviewed against Binary Ninja.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent RecoilApp main-loop/state-queue pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x442d00 validates SetThreadPriority, PeekMessage/PumpMessage/ExitInstance message handling, DirectPlay receive polling, skip-wait WaitMessage gating, state-queue dispatch for exit/push/switch items, current-state OnUpdateShouldQuit, OnAppDeactivate, and PostQuitMessage(0).

The native recoil_app_run_current_state_quit_smoke patches PeekMessageA, PostQuitMessage, WaitMessage, SetThreadPriority, and zNetworkDPlay::ReceivePendingMessages, then verifies the no-message/current-state-quit path calls the state update hook, deactivates the app, posts quit, pumps one synthetic message, exits through ExitInstance, and does not call WaitMessage.

The native recoil_app_run_queue_transitions_smoke drives Run through queued switch-current, push-state, and exit-current items, verifying the expected state vtable calls, stack mutations, queue item consumption, and deterministic loop exit without WaitMessage.
